name: Common base for the Xpert Style detectors. Base only c/w Xpert card- LPCB APPROVED
family: Context Plus Xpert Card Based Analogue Addressable Detectors
summary: The Context Plus Mounting Base 45681-210IMC is a low insertion force base with stainless steel contacts for the detector terminals. XPERT cards are supplied with all bases.
features: XPERT Addressing. Universal address cards, known as XPERT cards, are supplied with all bases.
Locking feature to prevent unauthorised detector removal.
Detectors fit into bases one way only, without snagging, and require clockwise rotation without push force to be plugged in.
Base have a wide interior diameter for ease of access to cables and terminals and there are two slots for fixing screws.
